overview.zh: 连接香港的现代滨海城市，主题景区、城市公园、生态园林和当代公共空间较丰富。
overview.en: A modern coastal city linked to Hong Kong, with theme attractions, urban parks, botanical landscapes, and contemporary public spaces.

provider.zh: 中国气象局公共气象服务
provider.en: China Meteorological Administration public weather service

note.zh: 查看深圳实时预报后，再到中央气象台核验暴雨、强对流和台风等预警。
note.en: Check Shenzhen's live forecast, then review rainstorm, severe-weather, and typhoon alerts from the National Meteorological Center.

name.zh: 深圳市文化广电旅游体育局
name.en: Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, Television, Tourism and Sports

operator.zh: 深圳市文化广电旅游体育局
operator.en: Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, Television, Tourism and Sports

use_for.zh: 查看深圳文化、旅游、体育资讯、活动和政务公告。
use_for.en: Use for Shenzhen culture, tourism, sports news, events, and government notices.

international_gateways.zh: 深圳北站高速铁路枢纽
与香港连接的陆路口岸（规则和开放时间需实时核验）
international_gateways.en: Land crossings to Hong Kong, with rules and hours requiring live checks

notes.zh: 深圳东西跨度较大，东部华侨城、盐田海岸与南山主题景区不宜在同一天密集往返。
notes.en: Shenzhen stretches far east to west; OCT East and the Yantian coast should not be packed into the same day as Nanshan theme attractions.

notes.zh: 跨境交通、口岸资格和签注不属于本静态数据范围。
notes.en: Cross-border transport, entry eligibility, and visa endorsements are outside this static dataset.

tradeoff.zh: 主题景区和滨海公共空间方便；去东部景区距离很远。
tradeoff.en: Convenient for theme attractions and waterfront public space; very far from eastern attractions.

tradeoff.zh: 城市交通和跨区中转方便，但不是多数大型景区的门口。
tradeoff.en: Good for city transport and cross-city transfers, but not at the entrance to most major attractions.

tradeoff.zh: 适合东部山海与华侨城行程；前往南山和宝安耗时。
tradeoff.en: Best for eastern mountain-coast plans and OCT East; time-consuming for Nanshan and Bao'an.

clothing.en: Light, breathable clothing with rain protection.

clothing.zh: 速干衣物，室内准备薄外套。
clothing.en: Quick-drying clothes with a light layer indoors.

clothing.zh: 轻便衣物，夜间和海边加薄层。
clothing.en: Light clothing with a thin evening or coastal layer.

clothing.zh: 长袖和轻外套，冷空气到来时增加防风层。
clothing.en: Long sleeves and a light jacket, adding wind protection during cold fronts.

culture.zh: 移民城市与改革开放历史
客家文化与城中村更新

dietary_notes.zh: 常见虾、猪肉、小麦、花生和芝麻，过敏者逐项询问。
dietary_notes.en: Shrimp, pork, wheat, peanuts, and sesame are common; ask item by item for allergies.

dietary_notes.zh: 通常含大豆和肉馅，汤汁或酱料成分需确认。
dietary_notes.en: Usually contains soy and meat filling; confirm broth or sauce ingredients.

dietary_notes.zh: 先确认计价单位、做法和过敏原；不要食用来源不明的野生动物。
dietary_notes.en: Confirm pricing unit, preparation, and allergens; do not consume wildlife from unclear sources.

name.zh: 深圳华侨城旅游度假区

ticket.note: Window of the World, Splendid China Folk Village, Happy Valley, and other venues sell separate products.

booking.note: Choose one component venue first, then check its official ticketing and show schedules.

summary.zh: 官方 5A 名录对应的综合度假区，包含世界之窗、锦绣中华民俗村、欢乐谷、欢乐海岸等不同运营场所；一天通常只安排一个主园区。
summary.en: The official 5A resort entry covers distinct venues including Window of the World, Splendid China Folk Village, Happy Valley, and OCT Harbour; usually choose one main park per day.

note.zh: 每个园区开放、检修、演出和票务规则独立。
note.en: Each venue has independent opening, maintenance, show, and ticket rules.

scope_note.zh: 5A 等级适用于深圳华侨城旅游度假区整体；官方页列出世界之窗、锦绣中华民俗村、欢乐谷和欢乐海岸等组成部分，不表示每个场所单独为 5A。
scope_note.en: The 5A rating applies to Shenzhen OCT Tourist Resort as a whole; the official page lists component venues but does not make each one a separate 5A site.

ticket.note: The resort combines separately operated leisure, sports, culture, and commercial activities.

booking.note: Identify the intended facility before checking access and reservation rules.

summary.zh: 位于龙华观澜的大型休闲旅游区，内部体验分散且部分为商业项目，不能按单一公园理解。
summary.en: A large leisure tourism area in Guanlan with dispersed and partly commercial experiences; it is not a single park.

note.zh: 各设施需分别核验开放资格、预约和费用。
note.en: Check access eligibility, reservations, and fees for each facility.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应深圳官方名录中的观澜湖休闲旅游区整体。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Mission Hills Leisure Tourism Area as a whole in Shenzhen's official list.

name.zh: 东部华侨城旅游度假区

ticket.note: Operating zones and ticket products may change; verify the exact attraction.

booking.note: Confirm current open zones, maintenance, shuttle service, and last entry.

summary.zh: 盐田山地中的大型度假景区，市区往返和园内移动耗时较多，应独立安排一天。
summary.en: A large mountain resort in Yantian; central-city transfers and internal movement make it a dedicated day trip.

note.zh: 园区分区和运营项目可能调整，请勿依赖旧攻略。
note.en: Operating zones and activities may change; do not rely on old guides.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应深圳官方名录中的东部华侨城旅游度假区整体。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to OCT East Tourist Resort as a whole in Shenzhen's official list.

ticket.note: Verify garden entry and internal transport charges.

booking.note: Confirm reservation, entry gate, internal shuttle, and temple access.

summary.zh: 结合植物专类园、湖区、山地步道和宗教场所的综合园区，入口选择和接驳会影响体力。
summary.en: A broad garden of plant collections, lake, hill paths, and an active religious site; gate and shuttle choices affect effort.

warnings: Respect active worship and dress expectations

note.zh: 园区、接驳和宗教活动安排需当天核验。
note.en: Verify garden, shuttle, and worship access for the day.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应深圳官方名录中的仙湖植物园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Fairy Lake Botanical Garden in Shenzhen's official list.

ticket.note: Entry and selected experiences may be separate.

booking.note: Check admission, show schedules, animal welfare notices, and transport.

summary.zh: 西丽湖片区的大型动物园，园区广且户外活动多，炎热月份需要降低强度。
summary.en: A large zoo near Xili Lake with extensive outdoor areas; reduce intensity in hot months.

warnings: Animals may be less active later in hot weather

note.zh: 动物展示和演出可能受天气与运营调整影响。
note.en: Animal areas and presentations may change with weather and operations.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应深圳官方名录中的深圳市野生动物园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Shenzhen Safari Park in Shenzhen's official list.

ticket.note: Public waterfront areas are generally free; rides, performances, and businesses charge separately.

booking.note: Check individual attraction and event rules.

summary.zh: 由滨海公园、商业、演艺与摩天轮等组成的开放式片区，适合傍晚到夜间。
summary.en: An open waterfront district of park space, commerce, performances, and a Ferris wheel, best from late afternoon into evening.

note.zh: 公共空间、摩天轮和演出各自有运营安排。
note.en: Public space, Ferris wheel, and performances have separate operations.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应深圳官方名录中的欢乐港湾旅游景区整体。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Happy Harbor Tourism Area as a whole in Shenzhen's official list.
